name: Flectar Mail
title: Flectar Mail: free Superhuman alternative
hook: Superhuman charges you thirty bucks a month to get through your email faster. This app does it for free.

features.say: It opens instantly, and runs on as little as eighty megabytes of memory.
Browser-style tabs keep every conversation, your calendar and contacts open at once.
Add your email accounts, and it even works offline.

caption:
Superhuman charges $30/month. Flectar Mail reads your email super fast for free ⚡

✅ Opens instantly, as little as 80 MB of RAM
✅ Tabs, calendar and contacts in one native app
✅ Remote images blocked by default, so no tracking pixels
✅ No subscription, no tracking, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux (Android test build too)
ℹ️ It's an early alpha, not stable yet. Gmail and Outlook sign-in needs your own sign-in keys for now, IMAP, POP3 and JMAP work out of the box. Windows and Mac builds are unsigned, so expect a security prompt on first launch.
